info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Refunds-v3-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Refunds API allows event organizers and ticketing platforms to manage the redemption of refunds for ticket purchases. This API provides access to a list of tickets eligible for refunds, enabling efficient processing of customer requests. Typical consumers include event managers, customer support teams, and ticketing service providers who need to handle refund inquiries and transactions seamlessly. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their customer service and streamline refund operations, ensuring that users are promptly attended to.

get.summary: Retrieve a refund for a ticket.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information regarding a refund for a specific ticket. You can use this operation to check the status of a refund or to view the details associated with the refund request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund for a ticket. It includes necessary details that must be provided to process the refund successfully.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the refund request.

state.description: The current state of the refund request.

audit.description: Audit information regarding the refund operation.
